name: Hospital Ledger
description: A free public database of U.S. hospital price transparency machine-readable files — where each hospital published one, whether it is live, and what is in it. Built by standardizing the files hospitals publish — the registry behind it tracks more facilities than CMS's own published hospital list — plus live verification. CC0 licensed.

tools.name: search_hospitals
tools.description: Search U.S. hospitals by name, city, or CCN in the Hospital Ledger dataset and return matching hospitals with city, state, type, live price-file status, and their Hospital Ledger URL.

query.description: Hospital name, city, or CCN fragment, e.g. 'Alaska Native' or 'Anchorage'

tools.name: get_procedure_prices
tools.description: Compare published prices for one CPT or HCPCS procedure code across U.S. hospitals — gross, cash, and min/max negotiated prices plus site-wide median cash price — from Hospital Ledger's cross-hospital procedure index.

code.description: CPT or HCPCS code, e.g. '99213' (office visit) or '45378' (colonoscopy)

tools.name: get_hospital_prices
tools.description: Return a hospital's published standardized price rows (code, description, gross, cash, and min/max negotiated prices) from Hospital Ledger, by the hospital's 6-character CCN.

tools.name: navigate_to_hospital
tools.description: Navigate the visitor's browser to a hospital's Hospital Ledger page, by its 6-character CCN. Only internal /hospital/<ccn> paths are used.
